Comment: VLCFA esterified to cholesterol → CE(24:0) and CE(26:0) accumulate in adrenal cortex lipid droplets
C24:0 also esterified to cholesterol; CE(24:0) is a major accumulated species in adrenal foamy cells
Males more severely affected in adrenal glands; adrenal insufficiency in ~70% of males but rare in females
Expanded adrenal lipid droplets impair StAR-mediated cholesterol import → cortisol/aldosterone deficiency
Adrenal insufficiency is an independent severity dimension; often precedes neurological symptoms by years
Untreated adrenal insufficiency worsens overall ALD disease burden and may accelerate cerebral progression
